locations.name: King Black Dragon Lair
travel: Pull the lever in the Wilderness Dungeon north of the Lava Maze (level 42 Wilderness).
A KBD heads teleport lands in the lair if you have one.
Games necklace to Corporeal Beast, then run north-west to the dungeon.
Bring antifire protection. The entrance is in multi-combat Wilderness.

locations.name: Cerberus' Lair
travel: Taverley Dungeon to the hellhound area, then enter the iron winch (91 Slayer).
Slayer ring teleport to Taverley Dungeon / Cerberus if unlocked.
Bring three Cerberus crystals or an eternal key to skip the key room.

locations.name: Callisto's den
travel: Burning amulet to the Lava Maze, then run south-east.
Games necklace to Corporeal Beast and run north-east.
Deep Wilderness multi-boss. Expect PKers.

locations.name: Artio's den
travel: Quetzal transport toward the Hunter Guild, then enter Artio's cave.
Pendant of ates or Civitas teleport, then fly a quetzal west.
Single-way wilderness bear boss alternative to Callisto.

locations.name: Venenatis' den
travel: Burning amulet to the Graveyard, then run east.
Games necklace to Corporeal Beast and run east.
Multi-combat Wilderness spider boss.

locations.name: Spindel's cave
travel: Drakan's medallion to Ver Sinhaza, then run west to the Web Chasm.
Fairy ring CKS and run south-east toward Slepe / the chasm.
Single-way Venenatis alternative.

locations.name: Crash Site Cavern
travel: Gnome glider to the Crash Site, then enter the cavern (Monkey Madness II).
Ape Atoll teleport and run to the crash site.
Demonic gorillas require 70 Agility or the MM2 path.

locations.name: Skotizo's lair
travel: Use a dark totem on the Catacombs of Kourend altar.
Kourend Castle teleport, statue into the catacombs, then run to the centre.
Each kill consumes a dark totem.

locations.name: TzHaar Fight Cave
travel: Amulet of glory to Karamja, then enter the volcano and the Fight Cave.
Fire cape teleport to Mor Ul Rek if you already have a cape.
TzTok-Jad is the final wave. This is a long instanced cave.

locations.name: The Inferno
travel: Fire cape to enter Mor Ul Rek, then enter The Inferno.
TzKal-Zuk is the final wave. This is a long, difficult instance.

locations.name: Scorpia's cave
travel: Ghorrock teleport and run south-east, or burning amulet to the Lava Maze and north.
Poisonous Wilderness boss. Bring antipoison and expect PKers.

locations.name: Obor's arena
travel: Edgeville Dungeon hill giant rooms; use a giant key on the gate.
Glory to Edgeville, down the trapdoor, then south to the giants.
Each kill consumes a giant key.

locations.name: Bryophyta's lair
travel: Varrock Sewers moss giant area; use a mossy key on the gate.
Varrock teleport, enter the sewers, and run to the moss giants.
Each kill consumes a mossy key.

locations.name: Royal Titans
travel: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon (fairy ring AIQ). The Titans are west of the main cavern.
60 Agility shortcut just west of the dungeon ladder.
Giantsoul amulet teleports to the entrance after you own one.

locations.name: Dagannoth Kings
travel: Waterbirth Island dungeon to the kings' lair (pet rock or a team, or the lighthouse path).
Waterbirth teleport or talk to Jarvald in Rellekka.
Prime is magic, Rex is melee, Supreme is ranged.

locations.name: Kalphite Queen lair
travel: Kalphite Lair (two ropes the first time), then down to the Queen chamber.
Desert amulet 4 or fairy ring BIQ and run north-west.
Protect from Magic or ranged depending on her form.

locations.name: Darkmeyer
travel: Drakan's medallion to Darkmeyer after Sins of the Father.
Vyrewatch Sentinels patrol the city streets.
A slayer's staff or Ivandis flail / blisterwood is required to damage vyres.

locations.name: Jatizso ice trolls
travel: Fremennik Isles after The Fremennik Isles quest; boat from Rellekka.
Ice trolls surround Jatizso. Weiss ice trolls also count.

locations.name: Porazdir
travel: Fought during A Kingdom Divided; afterwards check the wiki for the replay location.
Counts as a black demon. Bring demonbane if you have it.

locations.name: Deathwing
travel: Wilderness bats east of the Graveyard of Shadows include Deathwings.
Burning amulet to the Graveyard, then look along the eastern woods.

locations.name: Varlamore buffalo
travel: Quetzal transport across the Avium Savannah where buffalo graze.
Pendant of ates or Civitas teleport, then fly toward the savanna.

locations.name: Zamorak God Wars
travel: God Wars Dungeon Zamorak encampment. Wear a Zamorak item.
Trollheim teleport and run north to the hole.
K'ril Tsutsaroth and Balfrug Kreeyath are inside.

locations.name: Armadyl God Wars
travel: God Wars Dungeon Armadyl encampment. Ranged, magic, or a halberd required.
Wear an Armadyl item. 70 Ranged is needed for the dungeon approach.

locations.name: Shellbane Gryphon Cave
travel: Fairy ring CJQ, then walk north to the cave.
Task-only (or elite clue). Elder Nama guards the entrance.
Solo instance. No cannon.

locations.name: Jormungand's Prison
travel: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon to the basilisk area, then into Jormungand's Prison (60 Slayer).
Slayer ring teleport to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon.
Wear a mirror shield or V's shield.

Abhorrent spectre.notes: Superior aberrant spectre. Same locations as the task; wear a nose peg or slayer helmet.

Abyssal Sire.notes: Instanced abyssal demon boss. Slower than catacombs bursting but much better unique drops.

Albino bat.notes: Larger bat variant. Counts for bat tasks.

Amoxliatl.notes: Frost nagua boss in the Ruins of Tapoyauik. Counts for lesser nagua tasks.

requiredItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Alchemical Hydra.notes: Four-phase hydra boss. Swap prayers as she changes colour. Best hydra task money.

Ammonite Crab.notes: AFK crabs on Fossil Island's east beach. Counts for crab tasks.

Ancient Custodian.notes: Superior elder custodian stalker. Same Stalker Den as the task.

requiredItems: Elemental, mind, or ancient wyvern shield
Ancient wyvern.notes: Highest wyvern. Bring a wyvern shield. Counts for Fossil Island wyvern tasks.

Ancient zygomite.notes: Fossil Island or Stalker Den zygomite. Finish them with fungicide.

Araxxor.notes: Araxyte boss. Much slower than cave araxytes but far better unique drops. Bring antivenom.

Artio.notes: Single-way Callisto alternative in Varlamore. Counts for bear tasks.

Blood-starved venator.notes: Superior venator. Same Vampyrium hunting grounds as the task.

Baby black dragon.notes: Weaker black dragons. Still require antifire protection. Counts for black dragon tasks.

Baby blue dragon.notes: Low-combat blue dragons. No dragonfire. Counts for blue dragon tasks.

Baby green dragon.notes: Low-combat green dragons. Wilderness babies are for Krystilia only.

Baby red dragon.notes: Low-combat red dragons. Bring antifire protection.

Balfrug Kreeyath.notes: Zamorak GWD minion. Counts for black demon tasks. Wear a Zamorak item.

Basilisk Knights.notes: Jormungand's Prison basilisks. Better loot than regular basilisks. Wear a mirror shield or V's shield.

Basilisk Sentinel.notes: Superior Basilisk Knight. Same prison as the knights. Wear a mirror shield or V's shield.

Black Heather.notes: Named Wilderness bandit. Counts for bandit tasks. Bring PvP protection.

Branda the Fire Queen.notes: Royal Titan. Fight her with Eldric in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon. Counts for fire giant tasks.

Bronze dragon.notes: Weakest metal dragon. Catacombs is safer than Brimhaven. Bring antifire.

Brutal black dragon.notes: Catacombs black dragon variant. Counts for black dragon tasks.

Brutal blue dragon.notes: Strong catacombs blue dragon. Uses all three styles. Dragonbane and antifire recommended.

Brutal green dragon.notes: Ancient Cavern green dragons. Require Barbarian Firemaking. Bring antifire.

Brutal red dragon.notes: Strong catacombs red dragon. Dragonbane and antifire recommended.

Bryophyta.notes: Moss giant boss in Varrock Sewers. Each kill uses a mossy key. Counts for moss giant tasks.

Buffalo.notes: Varlamore cattle. Counts for cow tasks.

Callisto.notes: Wilderness bear boss. Multi-combat. Artio is the safer single-way alternative.

Cave abomination.notes: Superior cave horror. Protect from Melee blocks the scream, so a witchwood icon is optional. Same cave as the task.

requiredItems: Three Cerberus crystals or an eternal key
Cerberus.notes: Hellhound boss. Prayer-flick her mage hits and keep ghosts off you. Does not count for dog tasks.

Chilled jelly.notes: Tapoyauik jelly. Counts for jelly tasks.

Chasm Crawler.notes: Superior cave crawler. Same Fremennik, swamp, Dorgesh-Kaan, and Tapoyauik caves.

Chicken.notes: Counts for bird tasks. Anywhere with chickens works.

Choke devil.notes: Superior dust devil. Burst in the Catacombs or Smoke Dungeon.

requiredItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Colossal Hydra.notes: Superior hydra. Same Karuulm floor as the task.

Cockathrice.notes: Superior cockatrice. Wear a mirror shield or V's shield.

Cow calf.notes: Young cows. Counts for cow tasks.

Desert Lizard.notes: Standard desert lizard. Finish with an ice cooler. Counts for lizard tasks.

Crushing hand.notes: Superior crawling hand. Slayer Tower or Meiyerditch Laboratories.

Dagannoth fledgeling.notes: Younger dagannoth. Lighthouse basement is the usual spot.

Dagannoth Prime.notes: Magic Dagannoth King. Wear magic defence and range him. Counts for dagannoth tasks.

Dagannoth Rex.notes: Melee Dagannoth King. Safe-spot with magic. Counts for dagannoth tasks.

Dagannoth Supreme.notes: Ranged Dagannoth King. Protect from Missiles. Counts for dagannoth tasks.

Deathwing.notes: Wilderness bat. Counts for bat tasks. Krystilia only if you need Wilderness credit.

Demonic gorilla.notes: Prayer-swap whenever they switch style. Counts for black demon tasks. Requires Monkey Madness II.

Deviant spectres.notes: Catacombs spectres. Stronger than Slayer Tower aberrants. Wear face protection.

Donny the lad.notes: Named Wilderness bandit. Counts for bandit tasks.

Dire gryphon.notes: Superior gryphon. Same Great Conch caves as the task. Wear a tortugan shield and 40 kg to stop knockback.

Dreadborn Araxyte.notes: Superior araxyte. Same Morytania Spider Cave as the task. Bring antivenom.

Earthen nagua.notes: Tonali Cavern earthen nagua. Counts for lesser nagua tasks.

Elder Aquanite.notes: Superior aquanite. Can disable Protect from Magic if you leave it on too long.

Elder custodian stalker.notes: Highest regular custodian. Stalker Den. Counts for custodian stalker tasks.

Elder Chaos druid.notes: Wilderness chaos druids. Fast XP but expect PKers. Counts for chaos druid tasks.

Feral vampyre.notes: Low-level vampyre around Canifis. Any melee works.

Flaming pyrelord.notes: Superior pyrefiend. Same locations as the task.

Frost nagua.notes: Tapoyauik frost nagua. Counts for lesser nagua tasks.

Flight Kilisa.notes: Armadyl GWD minion. Counts for aviansie tasks. They fly — use ranged, magic, or a halberd.

Flockleader Geerin.notes: Armadyl GWD minion. Counts for aviansie tasks.

Frost Crab.notes: Varlamore / sailing frost crabs. Counts for crab tasks.

Giant bat.notes: Standard large bat. Counts for bat tasks.

requiredItems: Bag of salt or slayer helmet
Giant rockslug.notes: Superior rockslug. Same Fremennik, swamp, Dorgesh-Kaan, and Tonali caves.

Greater abyssal demon.notes: Superior abyssal demon. Same locations as the task. Demonbane recommended.

Greater Nechryael.notes: Stronger nechryael. Catacombs, Iorwerth, or the Wilderness Slayer Cave.

Grimy Lizard.notes: Neypotzli or Tonali Cavern. Finish with an ice cooler. Counts for lizard tasks.

requiredItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Guardian Drake.notes: Superior drake. Same Karuulm floor as the task. Step aside of the dragonfire line.

Grizzly bear.notes: Standard bear. Counts for bear tasks. Callisto and Artio are the boss alternatives.

Grotesque Guardians.notes: Dawn and Dusk on the Slayer Tower roof. Counts for gargoyle tasks. Bring a rock hammer or slayer helmet.

Guard dog.notes: Counts for dog tasks. McGrubor's Wood and Brimhaven are common spots.

Ice troll.notes: Jatizso or Weiss. Counts for troll tasks. Weiss is closer with icy basalt.

Insatiable Bloodveld.notes: Superior bloodveld. Same locations as the task.

Infernal pyrelord.notes: Superior pyrelord. Isle of Souls or Sisterhood Sanctuary. Counts for pyrefiend tasks.

Insatiable mutated Bloodveld.notes: Superior mutated bloodveld. Same Catacombs / Iorwerth / Meiyerditch locations.

Iorwerth warrior.notes: Elf warrior variant. Iorwerth Dungeon is the usual cannon/burst spot.

Iron dragon.notes: Mid-tier metal dragon. Dragonbane and antifire. Catacombs is safer than Brimhaven.

Jackal.notes: Desert dogs. Counts for dog tasks.

K'ril Tsutsaroth.notes: Zamorak GWD boss. Counts for greater demon tasks. Wear a Zamorak item. Demonbane is strong.

Kalphite Queen.notes: Two-form kalphite boss. Swap prayers when she changes form. Counts for kalphite tasks.

King Black Dragon.recommendedStyle: Melee or ranged with dragon hunter gear
King Black Dragon.notes: Does not count for Krystilia. Super antifire lets you drop the shield. Wilderness lever entrance.

Juvenile custodian stalker.notes: Lowest custodian variant. Stalker Den. Counts for custodian stalker tasks.

requiredItems: Leaf-bladed weapon, broad bolts, or magic dart
King kurask.notes: Superior kurask. Same Fremennik Slayer Dungeon as the task.

Kraken.notes: Instanced cave kraken boss. Use a fishing explosive on the large whirlpool. Attacks hit through Protect from Magic, so bring food. Counts for cave kraken tasks.

Kree'arra.notes: Armadyl GWD boss. Counts for aviansie tasks. They fly — ranged or magic only.

Lava Strykewyrm.weakness: 50% water weakness. Fire spells heal them.
Lava Strykewyrm.notes: Charred Dungeon or Wyrmscraig — not Karuulm. Fire spells heal them. 50% water weakness.

requiredItems: Shayzien helm (5) to ignore poison splats
Lizardman shaman.notes: Jump and poison-splat mechanics. Shayzien helm (5) skips the poison. Counts for lizardman tasks.

requiredItems: Elemental, mind, or ancient wyvern shield
Long-tailed wyvern.notes: Fossil Island wyvern variant. Bring a wyvern shield.

Magma strykewyrm.weakness: 50% water weakness. Fire spells heal them.
Magma strykewyrm.notes: Superior lava strykewyrm. Charred Dungeon or Wyrmscraig. Move two tiles when it burrows or take heavy damage.

requiredItems: Rock hammer, granite hammer, or rock thrownhammer
Marble gargoyle.notes: Superior gargoyle. Same Slayer Tower as the task. Finish with a rock hammer.

Mature custodian stalker.notes: Mid-tier custodian. Stalker Den. Counts for custodian stalker tasks.

Malevolent Mage.notes: Superior Infernal Mage. Slayer Tower as usual. Protect from Magic.

Sea mogre.notes: Ocean mogre on the Ardent Ocean. Counts for mogre tasks. No fishing explosive needed.

Mithril dragon.notes: Ancient Cavern. Requires Barbarian Firemaking. Dragonbane and antifire.

Monstrous basilisk.notes: Superior basilisk. Fremennik Slayer Dungeon. Wear a mirror shield or V's shield.

Moonlight Cockatrice.notes: Varlamore cockatrice. Wear a mirror shield or V's shield.

Mourner.notes: Level 108 mourners count as elves. West Ardougne / Lletya depending on quest progress.

Mutated Terrorbird.notes: Superior warped terrorbird. Same Poison Waste Dungeon. Crystal chime required. Wear earmuffs or a slayer helmet.

Mutated Tortoise.notes: Superior warped tortoise. Same Poison Waste Dungeon. Crystal chime required.

Mutated Bloodveld.notes: Preferred bloodveld variant. Meiyerditch Laboratories is the usual cannon spot.

Mutated zygomite.notes: Fossil Island zygomite. Finish with fungicide.

Nechryarch.notes: Superior nechryael. Same locations as the task. Burst in the Catacombs.

Night beast.notes: Superior dark beast. Same locations as the task.

Nuclear smoke devil.notes: Superior smoke devil. Same dungeon as the task.

Obor.notes: Hill giant boss. Each kill uses a giant key. Counts for hill giant tasks.

Pit Scorpion.notes: Smaller scorpion. Counts for scorpion tasks.

Porazdir.notes: Demon from A Kingdom Divided. Counts for black demon tasks. Demonbane recommended.

requiredItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite in Karuulm unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Shadow Wyrm.notes: Superior wyrm. Same caves as regular wyrms. Cannot be safespotted in the task-only alcove.

requiredItems: Boots of stone, brimstone, or granite unless Elite Kourend & Kebos Diary is complete
Sulphur Lizard.notes: Karuulm lizard. Counts for lizard tasks. No ice cooler needed.

Sulphur nagua.notes: Neypotzli. Counts for lesser nagua tasks.

Pyrelord.notes: Isle of Souls or Sisterhood Sanctuary. Counts for pyrefiend tasks.

Repugnant spectre.notes: Superior deviant spectre. Catacombs. Wear face protection.

Rock Crab.notes: Classic AFK crabs east of Rellekka. Counts for crab tasks.

Sand Crab.notes: AFK crabs on Crabclaw Isle or Hosidius shores. Counts for crab tasks.

Scorpia.notes: Wilderness scorpion boss. Poisonous. Bring antipoison. Counts for scorpion tasks.

Screaming banshee.notes: Superior banshee. Slayer Tower. Wear earmuffs or a slayer helmet.

Screaming twisted banshee.notes: Superior twisted banshee. Catacombs. Wear earmuffs or a slayer helmet.

Shellbane gryphon.notes: Task-only Great Conch boss. Wear a tortugan shield and 40 kg. Solo instance; no cannon.

Seagull.notes: Counts for bird tasks. Port Sarim docks are full of them.

Skeleton Hellhound.notes: Vet'ion's hellhounds (Wilderness) or the quest skeleton hellhound. Counts for hellhound tasks.

Skogre.notes: Undead ogre at Jiggig after Zogre Flesh Eaters. Counts for ogre tasks.

Skotizo.notes: Catacombs altar boss. Each kill uses a dark totem. Counts for black and greater demon tasks.

Speedy Keith.notes: Named Wilderness bandit. Counts for bandit tasks.

requiredItems: Leaf-bladed weapon, broad bolts, or magic dart
Spiked Turoth.notes: Superior turoth. Same Fremennik Slayer Dungeon as the task.

Spindel.notes: Single-way Venenatis alternative in the Web Chasm. Counts for spider tasks.

Spiritual mage.notes: Best spiritual creature (dragon boots). Requires 83 Slayer. Wear a god item.

Spiritual ranger.notes: God Wars, Wilderness God Wars, or Ancient Prison. Wear a god item.

Spiritual warrior.notes: God Wars, Wilderness God Wars, or Ancient Prison. Wear a god item.

requiredItems: Elemental, mind, or ancient wyvern shield
Spitting wyvern.notes: Fossil Island wyvern variant. Bring a wyvern shield.

Steel dragon.notes: High-defence metal dragon. Dragonbane and antifire. Catacombs is safer than Brimhaven.

Swamp Crab.notes: Higher-level crabs. Counts for crab tasks.

requiredItems: Elemental, mind, or ancient wyvern shield
Taloned wyvern.notes: Fossil Island wyvern variant. Bring a wyvern shield.

Terrorbird.notes: Gnome Stronghold birds. Counts for bird tasks.

Thermonuclear smoke devil.notes: Smoke devil boss. Counts for smoke devil tasks. Wear a face mask or slayer helmet.

Troll general.notes: Stronger troll in Trollheim / Death Plateau. Counts for troll tasks.

Twisted Banshee.notes: Catacombs banshee. Wear earmuffs or a slayer helmet.

TzKal-Zuk.notes: Inferno final boss. Counts for TzHaar tasks. This is a long, difficult instance.

TzTok-Jad.notes: Fight Cave final boss. Prayer-switch mage and ranged. Counts for TzHaar tasks.

Undead cow.notes: Undead cows north-west of Lumbridge. Counts for cow tasks. Salve works.

Venenatis.notes: Wilderness spider boss. Multi-combat. Spindel is the safer single-way alternative.

Vitreous warped Jelly.notes: Superior warped jelly. Catacombs. Counts for jelly tasks.

Vitreous Jelly.notes: Superior jelly. Same locations as the task.

Vorkath.recommendedStyle: Ranged or melee with dragon hunter gear
requiredItems: Anti-dragon shield, dragonfire ward, or dragonfire shield
Vorkath.notes: Counts for blue dragon tasks after Dragon Slayer II. Woox-walk acid and pray mage.

requiredItems: Hallowed flail, blisterwood, Ivandis flail, or a slayer's staff (e)
Vyrewatch Sentinel.notes: Darkmeyer vyres. Hallowed flail is BiS. Counts for vampyre tasks.

Warped Jelly.notes: Catacombs jelly. Counts for jelly tasks.

Warped terrorbird.notes: Poison Waste dungeon. Counts for warped creature tasks. Crystal chime required. Wear earmuffs or a slayer helmet.

Warped tortoise.notes: Poison Waste dungeon. Counts for warped creature tasks.

Wyrmling.notes: Neypotzli or Wyrmscraig — not Karuulm. No superior.

Wingman Skree.notes: Armadyl GWD minion. Counts for aviansie tasks.

Zogre.notes: Undead ogre at Jiggig after Zogre Flesh Eaters. Brutal arrows or crumble undead help.
